name: Shopify
label: Shopify Admin GraphQL 2026-07 — orders, products, inventory, webhooks
description: Shopify Admin GraphQL at https://{shop}.myshopify.com/admin/api/{api_version}/graphql.json. Docs: https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql. Every verb sends official {query, variables} — the Admin REST product/order resources are not used. Header X-Shopify-Access-Token. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Never log access_token.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One official API operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official API verb. EXACT: order_create | order_delete | order_get | order_list | order_update | product_create | product_delete | product_get | product_list | product_update | customer_get | inventory_adjust | fulfillment_create | trigger. Blank uses configurationParameters.operation. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not an HTTP call.

schema.label: query
schema.description: Admin GraphQL document for every HTTP op (order_*, product_*, customer_get, inventory_adjust, fulfillment_create). Required. Official POST {shop}.myshopify.com/admin/api/{api_version}/graphql.json body query. Example: mutation { orderCreate(order: {…}) { order { id } } }.

schema.label: variables
schema.description: Admin GraphQL variables object matching the query. Example: {"id":"gid://shopify/Order/1"}.

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data on 2xx. Secrets never present. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status. Never includes secrets.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. May contain order PII — do not log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb for OfficialApiNode. EXACT: order_create | order_delete | order_get | order_list | order_update | product_create | product_delete | product_get | product_list | product_update | customer_get | inventory_adjust | fulfillment_create | trigger. trigger does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: StudioQuack secret. Auth type header. Never log. Customer owns the merchant account.

configurationParameters.label: Api Version
configurationParameters.description: Year-month Admin API version. Pin. Do not send unstable.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout seconds (connect + read). <=0 uses api_spec defaultTimeout.
